item.text:
The **HVAC demand flexibility measures are upgrades 24–28** in ResStock 2025 Release 1. They differ in **when the thermostat changes, the temperature offset, and the duration of preconditioning**. [ResStock package list](https://resstock.nlr.gov/datasets)

| Upgrade | Measure | Thermostat action |
|---|---|---|
| **24** | On-peak load shedding, **2°F offset** | During peak hours, lowers the heating setpoint by 2°F or raises the cooling setpoint by 2°F. |
| **25** | Pre-peak load shifting, **4 hours, 2°F offset** | Preheats or precools the home with a 2°F offset during the four hours before the peak. |
| **26** | On-peak load shedding, **4°F offset** | Same approach as 24, with a larger 4°F adjustment. |
| **27** | Pre-peak load shifting, **4 hours, 4°F offset** | Same approach as 25, with a larger 4°F preconditioning adjustment. |
| **28** | Pre-peak load shifting, **1 hour, 2°F offset** | Same offset as 25, but preconditions for only one hour before the peak. |

These settings are documented in the [release README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf).

**Shedding reduces conditioning during the peak; shifting moves conditioning earlier.** For shifting, preheating raises the heating setpoint and precooling lowers the cooling setpoint. The final shifting scenarios do **not** also impose an on-peak setback. A 4°F offset is a stronger intervention than 2°F; four hours of preconditioning provides more opportunity to store heat or cooling in the building than one hour. [HVAC Load Flexibility measure documentation, Table 8](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/93846.pdf#page=32)

For analysis, these profiles represent **maximum technical potential**, with dispatch nearly every day. The release advises selecting event-day profiles rather than directly interpreting the modeled annual savings as a realistic demand-response program’s savings. [Release assumptions](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf)
